title: The Methodology of Purchasing medicines and medicinal equipment 	under Government to Government basis, where found necessary
decision_details: - Approval of the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at the  meeting  held  on 2025-05-19 to appoint a Senior Officials' Committee to prepare a methodology for selecting countries with potential to procure medicines of short supply under the  Government-to-Government basis. Accordingly, the draft methodology prepared by the Committee has been forwarded to the National Procurement Commission, and a methodology has been prepared for the procurement of medicines and medical equipment under Government-to-Government basis, based on the proposals and observations of the said Commission. The proposal made by the Minister of  Health and Mass Media, to enter into Memoranda of Understanding with the countries having the potential to purchase medicines and medicinal equipment as per the said methodology, in essential instances, and to enter into agreements with the institutions nominated by those Governments by the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation and secure medicines and medicinal equipment that are difficult to procure through the normal supply chain, was approved by the Cabinet.
